title: The Impact of M1/M2 Tumor Associated Macrophage (TAM) Polarization on Cancer Progression and Prognosis Prediction
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the correlation between M1/M2 phenotype of tumor associated macrophage (TAM) in lung cancer patients and clinical outcome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* lung cancer with malignant pleural effusions

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: patients diagnosed of lung cancer with malignant pleural effusions
